body.x: uSens has attended ‘CES 2018 Unveiled’ in Las Vegas, U.S, on Sunday, Jan. 7th, and introduced VR headset that tracks the hand movement.

uSens, a manufacturer of AR and VR HMD, cooperates with content creators and game developers to create the most immersive devices. The Fingo hardware introduced this time traces hand position and finger movements and brings you to the virtual world. The 26DOF tracking function enables realistic interaction with the surrounding environment.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years.
